```{python}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: Dependencies
from caipe_sim.three_level_model import run_sim
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
```

## Run default simulation

```{python}
%%time
times, n_pop, g_pop, e_pop, s_pop = run_sim()
```

## Plot simulation

```{python}
plt.plot(times, n_pop, label="Photon numbers")
plt.plot(times, g_pop, label="|e⟩ population")
plt.plot(times, e_pop, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(times, s_pop, label="|s⟩ population")
plt.plot(times, g_pop + e_pop + s_pop, label="Total population")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

## Parameter sweeps

### $\kappa$ sweep

```{python}
%%time
from caipe_sim.three_level_model import sweep_kappa
kap_vals, kap_g, kap_e, kap_s, kap_photon = sweep_kappa(0.01, 1, 100)
```

```{python}
plt.plot(kap_vals, kap_g, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(kap_vals, kap_e, label="|e⟩ population")
plt.plot(kap_vals, kap_s, label="|s⟩ population")
plt.plot(kap_vals, kap_photon, label="Photon population")
plt.title("Kappa sweep")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

### $\gamma$ sweep

```{python}
%%time
from caipe_sim.three_level_model import sweep_gamma
gam_vals, gam_g, gam_e, gam_s, gam_photon = sweep_gamma(0.01, 1, 100)
```

```{python}
plt.plot(gam_vals, gam_g, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(gam_vals, gam_e, label="|e⟩ population")
plt.plot(gam_vals, gam_s, label="|s⟩ population")
plt.plot(gam_vals, gam_photon, label="Photon population")
plt.title("Gamma sweep")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

### Rabi sweep

```{python}
from caipe_sim.three_level_model import sweep_rabi
rabi_vals, rabi_g, rabi_e, rabi_s, rabi_photon = sweep_rabi(0.01, 1, 100)
```

```{python}
plt.plot(rabi_vals, rabi_g, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(rabi_vals, rabi_e, label="|e⟩ population")
plt.plot(rabi_vals, rabi_s, label="|s⟩ population")
```

### $g$ sweep

```{python}
%%time
from caipe_sim.three_level_model import sweep_gval
gval_vals, gval_g, gval_e, gval_s, gval_photon = sweep_gval(0.01, 1, 100)
```

```{python}
plt.plot(gval_vals, gval_g, label="|g⟩ population")
plt.plot(gval_vals, gval_e, label="|e⟩ poopulation")
plt.plot(gval_vals, gval_s, label="|s⟩ population")
```
